notes: Fishing (prototype adaptation, 2026-11-17). Book: no fishing rule; Security covers survival (Core p.92); Fitness is physical prowess (p.89). Prototype: Fitness + Security at the spot's authored Difficulty.

Ring flow (designer 2026-11-17): click the ripple → Scan + Fish with party band. Fish opens the standard dice window (bonus d20s allowed, same as challenges). Success grants a shared fish into the party bag. Failure leaves the ripple. No Go To / Catch button / deplete / relocate.
Rod: party bag (shared: true). Without a rod Fish is dim and titled 'Fish: no rod.'.
